heading: Home Loan EMI Paid? Don't Forget These Crucial Documents
tldr: Once your home loan is fully repaid, collecting specific documents from your bank is a critical final step.
The 'No Dues Certificate' and the original property documents are paramount for establishing clear ownership.
RBI guidelines mandate banks to return original property documents within 30 days of loan closure, failing which compensation is due.
It's essential to update your CIBIL credit report and property records to reflect the loan closure.
Keep all loan-related documents, including repayment proofs, for future reference, especially for tax purposes.
caption:
Paid off your home loan? Congrats! 🎉 But hold on – there's one super important step many people miss. You need to collect specific documents from your bank to truly own your home free and clear. If you don't, it can cause big headaches later. Find out exactly which papers you need and why they matter in our latest article.
